# trefolio

> The European investor's portfolio tracker — EU tax reports, stock screener, AI insights, and net worth tracking in 35 languages.

## What is trefolio?

trefolio is a web-based portfolio tracker built for European retail investors. It offers EU-specific tax reports for Germany, France, Spain, Netherlands, and Italy (with AI Tax Assistant), a stock screener covering 600+ stocks, net worth tracking (real estate, savings, pensions), broker auto-sync via SnapTrade (20+ brokerages), 14 broker CSV import formats, AI-powered analysis in your native language, dividend tracking and projections, performance metrics (TTWROR, XIRR, Sharpe, Max Drawdown), and 4 dashboard themes. Available in 35 European languages with 21-currency support.

## Pricing

- Free (Folio): Up to 15 holdings, real-time quotes, charts, growth projection, broker import, earnings calendar, 5 AI calls/month
- Bifolio (€2.99/month or €23.99/year): 50 holdings, 20 AI calls/month, full portfolio history, advanced metrics, portfolio sharing, CSV export, 1 broker sync, Canvas theme
- Trefolio (€7.99/month or €59.99/year): Unlimited holdings, unlimited AI, EU tax reports (DE/FR/ES/NL/IT), stock screener, net worth tracking, fundamentals, all 4 themes, unlimited broker sync, IPO calendar
